text_en:
Maintenance Procedure Information System
 | Protection | Maintenance Procedures
Document No.: OCR-083-r0a | Equipment:
 Overcurrent and Earth Leakage Protection, SC
 Sepam 1000
Issued to: 
 Distribution Companies
Status: 
 Draft
Approval date: 
 2009 | Procedure:
 Using an injection device
Next review date: 2014
Introduction
The device performs many functions, including (overcurrent and earth leakage protection, short-circuit, disturbance recorders, fault recorders, and current measurements).
This document was prepared by Canal Electricity Distribution Company and was reviewed and approved by the MPIS coordinators.
Safety Precautions
Notify the competent control of the cells to be worked on by an approved official signal. | 
Issue an approved work order with all items completed. | 
Maintenance and test personnel must carry the occupational safety and health category card. | 
The cell circuit breaker shall be switched off by the competent operation technician on instructions from the competent control, and the circuit breaker placed in the test position. | 
Ensure warning signs are posted on the cells to be worked on. | 
Occupational safety and health instructions must be followed at the work site. | 
Do not open current transformer terminals while in service or under test. | 
Ensure the protection device is earthed in the cell. | 
Tools, Instruments and Equipment Used
Secondary injection device suitable for the digital protection device, supplied with its accessories, current injection leads and Trip leads for recording the tripping time. | 
A source for supplying the injection device with 220 VAC. | 
Procedures to be Carried Out
First: Overcurrent Test with a 5 Ampere Secondary Winding
Test values shall be determined and the devices programmed to operate on them according to the values and times agreed with the transmission companies (transformer station), so that the tripping time on outgoing feeders does not exceed (0.15 seconds) | 1.
The Sepam 1000 protection device shall be supplied with the appropriate operating voltage (charger output voltage) on the panel at points (1, 2) | 2.
Connect the current injection leads to the terminals of the first phase (R) of the protection device at points (4, 5) | 3.
Increase the injection current value gradually until reaching the rated value (I pick up) and tripping shall be effected by the protection device | 4.
Record this value (I pick up) and set the injection device to this value | 5.
Connect the Trip leads of the protection device to the points (the injection device to record the tripping time) | 6.
Inject the protection device with the stored current value in one shot and record the tripping time | 7.
Repeat the above with the second and third phases; connection shall be made according to the drawing at points (5, 6) & (4, 6) | 8.
Calculate the reset factor by reducing the secondary injection current until Reset occurs | 9.
Short-circuit unit SC element test: after setting the rated value of the short-circuit current and its instantaneous time, raise the injection current value to the rated current value of the short-circuit unit (20:30 amp/secondary) until the short-circuit unit operates; the time shall be instantaneous. Note: the protection device delay time (Delay Time) must be taken into account during setting | 10.
Second: Earth Leakage Test
Test values shall be determined and the devices programmed to operate on them according to the values and times agreed with the transmission companies (transformer station), so that the tripping time on outgoing feeders does not exceed (0.15 seconds) | 1.
The protection device shall be supplied with the appropriate operating voltage (charger output voltage) on the panel at points (1, 2) | 2.
Connect the current injection leads to the current transformer summation terminals of the protection device at points (3, 6) | 3.
Raise the current gradually until reaching the value (I pick up); tripping shall be effected by the protection device | 4.
Lower the current gradually until reaching the value I reset, then record it | 5.
Calculate the reset factor by KRE = I reset / I pick up | 6.
Connect the Trip leads of the protection device to the Timer points on the injection device to record the time | 7.
Inject the protection device with the stored current value in one shot and record the tripping time | 8.
To activate the short-circuit unit for earth of the earth leakage device, raise the current value above the rated current of the first stage (First Stage) while reducing the time to instantaneous | 9.
